about: Nuuk's Crystal-style Hoenn sprites (Facets' GBC ANIM set) as a SPRITE SWAPPER pack, with matching Game Boy party icons by eeveeee1999. Only the 92 Pokémon Nuuk drew; the rest stay the game's own. SPRITE SWAPPER shows still pictures, so Nuuk's animations stay in Facets.
name: Nuuk's GBC Hoenn
label: NUUK HOENN
description: Nuuk's Crystal-style sprites for 92 of Hoenn's Pokémon (Treecko to Crawdaunt, plus Snorunt and Glalie), with Game Boy party icons, from Facets.
notes: Still pictures only: for Nuuk's animations, use Facets' GBC ANIM set instead.
credit: Hoenn sprites by Nuuk (Crystal-style sprites), free to use with credit, not for profit
